alpha_source: world-digest typed implications through SHADOW_NEWS_v0's frozen news_signal (d > 0 only), sized by the TRUST RULE

inputs.name: world digest
inputs.read: services.world_digest.news_signal over the newest digest's typed implications

inputs.name: trust
inputs.rule: trust = world_digest.trust_from(): exactly 0 while graded news_digest dates < WORLD_DIGEST_TRUST_MIN_DATES (3); after that clip(posterior / WORLD_DIGEST_TRUST_FULL, 0, WORLD_DIGEST_TRUST_MAX) of the per-date Brier improvement over the row's own control, prior N(0, WORLD_DIGEST_TRUST_TAU^2). KEY 1 (per arm): n dates >= N_MDE, lower bound > 0, trust >= 0.05. KEY 2: the PC plan's own regret rows (decision_story plan_plus_shadow_news_full vs plan_full, net of round-trip cost): mean - 1.64 x se > 0 over >= NEWS_TILT_MIN_MDC_SESSIONS graded sessions. KEY 1 per arm: see NEWS_TILT_KEY1_*. Both, or the flag stays False.

selection.rule: long only: names with d_i > 0, strongest first, excluding bar-defect names and names that already moved > 2 five-session sigma; weight = 1% x (1 + 2 x usable_trust), usable_trust = 0 unless KEY 1 holds for the arm (n dates >= N_MDE, posterior lower bound > 0); at most 3%/name, 10 names, 30% gross; held 5 sessions then exited unless re-signalled. Trust is read, never edited; today usable_trust = 0 on both arms, so every name is 1%

exits: 5 sessions -> cash unless re-signalled; resting sigma stops

stop_rule.sigma: 63-session sd of close-to-close returns on the bar-defect-screened panel (Alpaca daily bars when a name is not in the panel)
stop_rule.distance: clip(k_sigma x sigma, min_frac, max_frac) of the reference price
stop_rule.never_loosen: a replaced stop is never below the stop it replaces
stop_rule.order: GTC sell stop for the full long quantity; renewed within 7 days of its expiry
stop_rule.why: a 5-session news hold; the v2 rule

twin.rule: the sleeve's own random twin from the same size x vol cell, drawn at entry with seed = hash(role, day); the rest of the account is cash in both

worst_case.gap_note: a stop is not a floor: an overnight gap fills below it
worst_case.line: 10 x 3.00% x 10% stop = -$3,000 if every stop fills at its distance; 3-sigma day at 4.92% = -$4,429 (capped at 10% -> -$4,429 by scaling gross x1.00); sum|notional|/equity 0.30; no-stop ceiling -$30,000

kill_rule: account drawdown >= 10% -> flatten, DEPRIORITIZED; digest older than 36 h -> no entries that day; at 63 sessions excess <= 0 vs both twin and SPY -> DEPRIORITIZED
